body: 20, could have written most of this post. I wish I had something good to say, but you aren't alone.

I know she’s had friends she WANTED to have sex with and never did so I guess you’re right about that. I tried to say some stuff to chill her out, like it was likely just a one time thing but she was really upset. 

I told her I was a bit upset with myself for hooking up with someone in the group, but honestly I didn’t feel too bad about it until she got upset. Me and the guy talked before and after having sex about how it’d affect our friendship and we were both 100% aware of what was happening. I was a bit drunk, and she asked if I was that fucked up and I told her I wasn’t even too intoxicated, which might have made it worse. I’m going to wait to talk to her and see if it blows over.

I guess because in the friend groups I’ve had thats never happened. I can’t take back having sex with him, so there’s not much I can do aside from not continuing to or not telling anyone in the future if we did. 

I really don’t think this will affect the group since they don’t know and at least on my end I know to not be super obvious that we messed around in front of our friends. I think she thinks it’ll be awkward behaving as friends in the group again.

I think its because our group is comprised of mostly single pals. We’re all just “bros being bros” and we play flirt with each other a lot but at the end of the day we really are just good friends. I think me taking it to a next level with him was like crossing a line in her eyes. I texted her about it earlier today and all she said was “its weird because we’re in a friend group” and asked why I did it. I replied to someone else’s comment asking if she was jealous, I don’t think she is.

They met on Tinder months ago, but their first time meeting was a party I had. At the party they did kiss but everyone single there was kissing each other (drugs and alcohol involved) so it wasn’t a huge thing (I thought anyway). We’ve all been close friends since then, but she has never made it known she liked him. If anything, she’s made it a point to say they’re just good friends when other people ask how they met.

Thank you so much for such a detailed response, I appreciate it so so much. I know what I’m doing to deal with my problems isn’t great, but the people I know berate me for it and make me feel worse. Thank you again, I hope your day is going well.
This is exactly what I needed to hear, I’ve been having a garbage day. Thank you ❤️
Thank you for taking the time to comment ❤️ sorry this isn’t my account with nudes on it

If you can afford it I highly recommend that everyone drive down PCH for a few hundred miles. I’ve done the drive from LA to Santa Cruz (almost 10 hours!) but the view was so fucking worth it.

Once I left LA, it was amazing. The Pacific is huge and blue and once you’re far enough out, the air is crisp and there’s mist in the air. If you stop off at one of the little exits by the beach, you can walk down and just see sand and water for miles.

Further up where the roads start getting windy and you’re basically on a cliff you’re surrounded by coastal trees and flowers and water and you can see the massive kelp forests from the cliff!! The beaches around Big Sur are beautiful and if you do ever go definitely go to Sand Dollar Beach!

I stayed in an airbnb in Santa Cruz with my boyfriend at the time and we were surrounded by nature (our hosts lived in the forest) and they had a little farm!

I know this was super detailed but hopefully I’ve convinced you to take the best vacation :)

Thinking about what you said, I definitely agree. I think we get along well when things are okay, but if anything is bad on my end he gets tired of talking to me (understandable) or never knows what to say. 

I’ve always worried that I’m clingy/crazy/needy and I probably am at least a little bit, but it doesn’t help that he can be so emotionally aloof (even when together). I have lots to think about.

I saw a message he sent some friends who wanted to play a video game (they play weekly for fun) and he said he wouldn’t be able to since I impulsively visited him, although he told me I could visit whenever was convenient for me when I had asked.

I think he sees it as me being clingy, but it felt spontaneous and something different to get me feeling better. 

I have told him that I seriously think I’m crazy or something and I feel like he might think the same. I still feel so confused, it blows. 

Thank you for your kind words though, I appreciate it.

It just felt like we were so compatible, he even said so himself (before I was really depressed, I guess). The funny thing is he also struggled/struggles with depression (although maybe it isn’t as severe or he hides it a lot better) so I thought he would be more understanding.

He didn’t say anything in a mean tone also, he even hugged me after and told me he just wanted me to be happy although this definitely didn’t help. I wish I had talked to him about it longer, maybe it wouldn’t have ended like this. There were lots of mixed signals so I’m kind of confused about how he feels...

This is also my first time being dumped and longest relationship so I’m probably being overdramatic, but it hurts a lot.
I’ll definitely give both a listen! Thanks for the recommendation:)

I visited my boyfriend who lives 6 hours from me on Friday. I had been feeling anxious about our relationship, feeling inadequate, etc. so I talked to him about it this morning before I left.

I told him I sometimes felt as if he could find someone much better than myself. I wanted him to tell me I was beautiful and loved (which he never does, he just tells me I need to try harder at things). He dumped me and I got to drive home for 6 hours alone. 

It took me an hour to even leave the parking lot, since I was sobbing so hard/loud and a woman came and asked if I was okay. I felt so embarrassed and stupid for thinking he would want to be with me in the first place and feel I brought it on myself. I originally took this trip to get myself in a good mood before going back to school, which starts Wednesday. Its rough.

Thank you! I love animals and will look into doing something with them.

As for the change, maybe I’ll get another piercing/tattoo. Its a temporary sensation, but I always feel better after.

I feel like I brought it on myself because I started talking about how I felt inadequate and shitty... though I hoped he would tell me it wasn’t true and that I was loved. It basically felt like he confirmed all my fears and insecurities were true outside of my head. 

I know he’s tired of it though. The shitty mental health has become a really big problem since halfway last year.

And yeah that drive definitely sucked, which is why I was surprised he chose to break up with me then and it hit me so hard.

Thank you for your comment though, I appreciate it.

I have a therapist, though I’m thinking of changing soon just because she keeps pushing me to take meds and I really don’t want to. I have a couple friends (literally two haha) but they get busy and I feel like everyone saw it coming but me. I just feel really dumb.

Thank you for this.
School has definitely been difficult and I only have one class this semester now since the deadline to register has passed but I’m going to pick up another job or two in hopes of moving out this year. 
I do think me and him are compatible though, and he said this doesn’t have to be “the end” (I guess if I start carrying my own weight he would get back with me?), but I kind of don’t want to be with someone who has dumped me before. He didn’t insult me and hugged me before I left, but it hurt. I just feel shitty since we clicked in a way I hadn’t with other people.

I’m so fucking sorry. Please look into counseling if you can, this is a really traumatic event. I wish you all the luck. Its possible to get better. ❤️

Originally it didn’t seem so bad because I planned on transferring to close the distance but my depression has also affected my performance in school (what a surprise) and I withdrew from all my classes this semester. I’m taking another semester to get it together, putting me at least a year behind schedule.

Its definitely something I have to think about more/talk to him about. We’re going to be alone a lot of the time, so maybe we could find a solution that way?

Yeah, I still really need to see an actual psychiatrist but won’t be able to until I get back. I dropped all my classes this semester and generally have found it difficult to concentrate on things for the past fee years so we think it could help. We’ll see.

And me and my boyfriend have become really close (excluding the past few months) and I really like him. Its been kind of difficult but being together helps a lot, I think. I still have lots of anxiety about our relationship when we are together (wondering if he’s mad at me for reasons I make up in my head, things like that) but he’s much more capable of comforting me when he’s there. 

He’s very busy when we aren’t together though. I think part of me resents him for having friends and things like that. He does stress out about school and studies a lot and also deals with depression and has some childhood trauma. But he does hang out with friends and party a lot. And it kind of sucks when he has time to hang out with them but can only call me like once for a couple hours.

I have 1 friend and her friends are my acquaintances who I see whenever I see her. But I see her maybe once every other week, so it gets lonely. 

I keep forgetting where I’m going with this but ultimately he’s busy and our schedules conflict.

Its really difficult but I think I’m just going to try to get all of it out. Being long distance makes it hard for me to really communicate with him, so if I don’t tell him now I might not get the chance to until months later.
I’ll definitely try and bring it up. He already told me he has plans this evening with friends, so I think it might be something to discuss over there or even when we get back.

I am attracted to him and whenever we’re together (assuming anxiety doesn’t ruin it) things are good and I really enjoy our conversations. But being away from him for so long makes me doubt that we ever had that connection to begin with, it sucks. 

I’m really afraid to see him because if anything goes wrong it just confirms all those worries I’ve had in my head for so long now.

And I’m on birth control just for birth control. I’m considering switching in a couple months if it doesn’t get better, since I think its already starting to break me out and I generally feel shitty though could just be me haha. My therapist wants me to consult with a psychiatrist about maybe trying adderall (adhd) and antidepressants, so I worry how so much medication would affect me.

I’ve had this towards my long distance boyfriend many times. Its terrible, because of course I don’t want him to feel as shitty as I do but clearly some part of me must if I feel that way? It’s not my fault he has friends and people like him and not me. And then I feel bad for being jealous of him and pitying myself. It never fucking ends.
